Privacy

This landing page has no analytics scripts, advertising, tracking cookies, contact forms, or accounts managed by cfast. Fonts and page assets are served with the website.

The website

The hosting provider may process ordinary request information, such as your IP address and browser, to serve and secure the page. Access to a private preview may be controlled by the host. See the hosting provider’s privacy policy.

Copy buttons use your browser’s clipboard only when you click them. The terminal is an illustrative demo; it does not execute or upload your code.

The local tool

cfast stores imported samples, metadata, and custom cases on your computer. The listener binds to your loopback interface. Testing saved cases runs locally. The installer downloads Python dependencies from package repositories.

External links

GitHub, Codeforces, and browser extension providers have their own privacy practices. Following links to those services is optional.

Questions

For questions about this website or the tool, open a GitHub issue. Do not post private code, credentials, or other sensitive information.
